Large_Radar_Like_Serval_Ears.description: This entity bears a pair of oversized, radar-like serval ears atop its head, granting it an enhanced perception and the ability to锁定目标, their keen hearing and feline agility allowing them to detect and track even the stealthiest of foes from afar.

Rounded_Snow_Leopard_Ears.description: Bristling with thick, silvery fur, the rounded snow leopard ears not only enhance your hearing in the whispering winds of the arctic but also grant you a feline grace and resilience against the biting cold, sharpening your senses and bolstering your constitution in the harshest of winters.

Tufted_Caracal_Antenna_Ears.description: The tufted caracal antenna ears, a feline marvel of nature, enhance the wearer's perception and agility, granting an unparalleled ability to navigate the shadows and detect the slightest movements with eerie precision.

Short_Pinned_Back_Lion_Ears.description: Emerging from the thick mane of fur that frames the wearer’s face, these short, pinned-back lion ears not only serve as a symbol of their inner feline spirit but also enhance their physical presence, making them appear more formidable and alert, ready to pounce at a moment's notice.

Swiveling_Cheetah_Wind_Ears.description: These extraordinary cheetah wind ears, sprouting from the wearer's head, grant unmatched swiftness and acute hearing, enabling them to detect the faintest sounds and movements, making them a lethal predator in any environment.

Angular_Cybernetic_Audio_Receptors.description: Bristling with intricate circuitry and sleek, angular plates, these cybernetic feline ears are seamlessly integrated into the skull, amplifying auditory perception and granting the user unparalleled awareness and the ability to pinpoint even the faintest sounds, enhancing their survival in the treacherous landscapes of the game world.

Broad_Flat_Pallas_Cat_Ears.description: These broad, flat Pallas cat ears, tipped with frost, grant heightened stealth and cold resistance, allowing the wearer to move silently through icy landscapes while their keen senses detect even the slightest movements and whispers of the wind.

Thick_Furred_Tiger_Ears.description: The Thick-Furred Tiger Ears, a regal appendage of feline majesty, bristle with sharp, pointed fur that enhances acute hearing and boosts one's perception of the world, granting an innate sense of vigilance and strength in the wilderness.

Long_Pointed_Siamese_Ears.description: These long, pointed Siamese ears, with their graceful feline appearance, enhance both agility and the keen sense of hearing, allowing their owner to detect the slightest sounds and react swiftly to their surroundings.

Whispy_Spectral_Ghost_Cat_Ears.description: These ghostly feline ears, translucent and wispy, grant an ethereal sight and a keen sense of stealth, their spectral nature adding an otherworldly wisdom to the bearer.
